sources.title: OpenAI GPT2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is used to instantiate a GPT-2 model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the GPT-2 openai-community/gpt2 architecture. Configuration objects inherit from PretrainedConfig and can be used to control the model outputs.
